name: MCP for Unity
what: A free, MIT-licensed bridge between AI assistants and the Unity Editor over MCP. From any MCP client you can create scenes and GameObjects, edit C# scripts, manage assets, run tests, profile and build. It is a community project, not affiliated with Unity Technologies.
who: Unity developers (Unity 2021.3 LTS through 6.x) who want Claude, Codex, Cursor or another MCP client to work directly in the editor.

setup.text: Needs Python 3.10+ via uv. In Unity, open Package Manager → Add package from git URL and paste:
In Unity, choose Window → MCP for Unity → Configure All Detected Clients.

setup.code: Create a cube at the origin and add a Rigidbody.

prompts: Create a third-person player controller script and attach it to a capsule.
Set up a simple level with a ground plane, three platforms and a spawn point.
Run the edit-mode tests and fix any failures.
